purpose: Final non-tuned Task14 base-context compression test: retain the orthogonal projection of native base deviation onto the span of both pre-existing frozen direction readers, exactly two scalars per edit.

prior_art_search.result: Zero-context absolute heads failed; the direction-specific one-reader correction improved strongly but missed. The reader artifact contains exactly two pre-existing non-collinear directions. Testing their full fixed span adds no learned direction, rank search, template split, or outcome fit and is the last licensed reader-based extension.

construction: Project native_base - mean_base orthogonally onto span{r_plural_to_singular, r_singular_to_plural} by solving the fixed 2x2 reader Gram system, then add that projection to the frozen absolute head. The only per-edit native state is the two reader dot products.

predictions.pred_a_immutable_two_reader_instrument: All inputs remain immutable; the two projection coordinates reproduce both native-base reader coordinates within 1e-5; source/downstream closure errors are at most 1e-4; all 512 cells join exactly.
predictions.pred_b_two_scalar_context_restores_effec: Across 512 cells, effects reproduce native exact effects at cosine at least 0.75, relative L2 at most 0.75, norm ratio 0.25 to 2.0, and sign agreement at least 0.75.
predictions.pred_c_each_direction_template_and_cardi: Every direction-by-template and cardinality group has cosine at least 0.65 and sign agreement at least 0.65.
predictions.pred_d_context_dependency_reduced_to_two: Replacement consumes exactly two native base-head scalar projections and the two frozen readers; no new direction, fit, rank choice, template, row, or outcome parameter is introduced.
predictions.pred_e_fixed_price_and_finality: Validation uses five forwards, 1,120 example evaluations, 1,024 installations, and zero fits/backwards/updates. If it fails, the reader-span base-compression route closes and the full native Task14 base head remains required.

terminal_rule: program_screen if all gates pass; null if instrument passes but two-scalar restoration fails; invalid on hash, Gram/projection identity, closure, join, or price mismatch.
closed_claims: rank greater than the two pre-existing readers
